done_when: After round 2, a canvas sign-off with only non-P0 gaps can be accepted by the owner, the gaps are kept as known issues, sign-off continues, and a P0 still blocks.
why: Canvas sign-off in src/forge/records.py (decision_accept, the branch that calls review.design_check) never reaches _signoff_review, so the owner's accept choice is read nowhere and is silently ignored. design_check in src/forge/review.py runs review.run with empty state and empty previous history, so no earlier rounds or settled findings reach the check and each run finds different P1s. A refused run never writes design_checked, so the roughly 40-minute check reruns on the same product.
